 Brazoria County District Court
 Cause No. 2026-CV-0013
 Kathleen Garcia, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
2-20-26
Counsel for defendant:
Richard Marshall, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant generally denies each and every allegation contained in Plaintiff's Original Petition and demands strict
proof thereof by a preponderance of the evidence, as required by the Texas Rules of Civil Procedure.
For further answer, and without assuming any burden of proof that the law places on Plaintiff, Defendant asserts the
following affirmative defenses.
First, Plaintiff's own negligence caused or contributed to the occurrence. Plaintiff failed to keep a proper lookout,
failed to control speed, and failed to maintain a safe distance behind the vehicle ahead. Under Chapter 33 of the
Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code, any recovery must be reduced by Plaintiff's percentage of responsibility,
and Plaintiff may be barred if that percentage exceeds fifty percent.
Second, Plaintiff's alleged damages were caused, in whole or in part, by a pre-existing condition, a prior injury, or a
subsequent unrelated event for which Defendant bears no responsibility.
Third, Plaintiff failed to mitigate damages by not following reasonable medical advice or by delaying treatment, and
any recovery must be reduced accordingly.
Defendant reserves the right to amend this answer as discovery proceeds.
</page>

  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
